name: Synergie
description: Play through the full Half-Life 2 saga and custom campaigns together.
longDescription: Play through the full Half-Life 2 saga and custom campaigns together.

name: Enterprise
description: This is a private, whitelisted world for us to hang out, build together, and explore at our own pace. Whether you want to build a massive mega-base, start a cozy town, or just chill in voice chat while mining, you're welcome here!
longDescription: This is a private, whitelisted world for us to hang out, build together, and explore at our own pace. Whether you want to build a massive mega-base, start a cozy town, or just chill in voice chat while mining, you're welcome here!

name: Turnedun
description: Grab your gear and get ready to survive.
longDescription: Grab your gear and get ready to survive.

name: Combine War
description: Resistance vs Combine Conquest: capture objectives, drain tickets, build your loadout.
longDescription: Team-based Half-Life 2 Conquest for Garry's Mod. Capture and hold objectives, drain the enemy's tickets, earn ranks and unlock attachments, and deploy with saved loadouts. Rounds end with an after-action report and MVPs.

name: Bag Run
description: Free-for-all city warfare: guns, cash, robberies and cars. Coming soon.
longDescription: An open-city free-for-all gamemode for Garry's Mod, part of the Torchline community. Earn cash, buy guns, rob stores and fight for the streets. In development.
